description: This file provides a utility function to perform process tree termination with a graceful shutdown that considers platform-specific behavior (Windows and Unix). It includes functions to normalize grace period durations, check process liveness, and invoke OS-specific commands to terminate process trees, with options for forceful termination if processes do not exit in time.
